question: Should Android adopt Kotlin 2.4.10 once the final rebased head passes the repository’s Android build, test, lint, and launch-smoke validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but accepting compiler-plugin behavior changes across the Android app is an owner-level compatibility decision that static review cannot settle.

options.title: Validate and adopt 2.4.10
options.body: Complete final-head Android validation and merge if both flavors build, tests and lint pass, and the installed app shows no Compose regression.

options.title: Defer the compiler update
options.body: Keep Kotlin 2.4.0 temporarily if owner testing finds recomposition, performance, or toolchain compatibility regressions.

recommendation.title: Validate and adopt 2.4.10
